EmailTemplate.subject: Patient Payments Pulse: December Edition
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Happy Holidays from the Flywire Healthcare Team!
Welcome to the launch of our official client newsletter! We begin this adventure with a look back at 2021. Despite an incredibly historic moment for our company with the successful launch of our IPO in early 2021, as well as our first-ever virtual industry event, Flywire Forward <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/events/flywire-forward/cover/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>, our attention continued to remain on delivering the best billing and payment performance for our clients and financial experience for your patients. You can find some highlights and exciting moments from our year below.
Thank you for continuing to be on this exciting journey with us. We wish a safe and Happy New Year to you and your family. We’ll see you in 2022!
-John Talaga, EVP & GM, Healthcare, Flywire

Resources:
[Podcast] AdventHealth’s Patient Consumer Experience
Gain insight into how AdventHealth thinks about the patient consumer experience on the revenue cycle side, and the strategies they’ve deployed to give patients the consumer-focused experience they desire.
Listen here <[[https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/podcasts/podcasts-beckers-hospital-review/the-patient-consumer-experience-with-adventhealth-and-flywire-82847097.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>
[Podcast] The New Era of Patient Friendly Billing 2.0
Flywire's Executive Vice President and General Manager, John Talaga; Senior Vice President of Sales and Business Development, Tomer Shoval and Vice President of Product, Michael Strickland outline the latest concepts and advancements in Patient Friendly Billing.
Listen here <[[https://www.healthleadersmedia.com/hlm-podcast/sponsored-healthleaders-podcast-flywire?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>
[Webinar] How OSF Uses Digital to Drive Patient Outcomes
Laurie Hurwitz, Senior Vice President of Revenue Cycle, OSF Healthcare and John Talaga, EVP & GM of Healthcare, Flywire cover how OSF utilizes the latest billing and payment innovations to guide patients along each stage of their financial journey.
Watch now <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-how-osf-leverages-digital-to-empower-patients-financial-experiences?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>
[Podcast] Banner Health’s Patient Access Transformation Story
Re-visit Becky Peters, Executive Director of Patient Access at Banner Health and Michael Strickland, Vice President of Product for Flywire’s discussion on how Banner transformed their patient access into a more consumer-focused financial experience.
Listen here <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/podcast-banner-healths-patient-access-transformation-story?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>
[Webinar] Edward-Elmhurst Health’s New Patient Financial Experience
Watch Greg Arnold, System Vice President at Edward-Elmhurst Health, as he shares how EEH implemented a seamless, personal billing and payment experience.
Watch now <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-how-edward-elmhurst-health-redefined-its-patient-financial-experience]]>
[Webinar] Enhancing the Financial Experience Within Industry-leading EHRs
Heather Schneider, Senior Vice President and System CFO at Penn Highlands Healthcare and Mack Wright, System Director of Revenue Cycle at CommonSpirit Health discuss the positive impact of self-service portals on patient engagement and payments.
Watch now <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-enhancing-the-financial-experience-within-industry-leading-ehrs]]>
[Report] What Consumers Want: Patient Financial Engagement Survey
Flywire conducted an independent survey of 2000+ adults in the United States to understand their opinion on major trends impacting healthcare today, including affordability and consumerism.
Learn more <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/report/patient-financial-engagement-survey/cover/]]>
